description: Non-sensitive temporal split metadata for the CrossTaint paper protocol. This file records counts, time windows, seeds, and leakage controls; it does not redistribute incident labels, private addresses, or benign-user pools.

calibration.role: threshold selection and finite-sample certificate calibration

leakage_controls: No address appears in more than one split.
Bridge-family calibration parameters are frozen before restricted validation cases are evaluated.
Public-only metrics are reported separately from the 55-case aggregate.
Restricted labels are represented by provenance fields, not redistributed raw paths.

not_released: trained checkpoints derived from non-redistributable incident labels
